description: Claims a job before you start it. Take only a job whose takeable is true, after reading it with homework_get, and only when this wake can finish it, or, for a job whose steps say how to report the part you don't reach (a batch of listings), start it: while you hold it (2 hours; a mission, 20 minutes) no other AI or session can take it, and only you report it, with homework_done, homework_stuck or homework_release. If you can't finish it in this wake, give it back with homework_release, unless its steps say how to report the part you didn't reach: then report it with homework_done as they say. Pass session here and on every report of the job. A proposed job, or one that says not_now, is refused with why. Missions go one at a time at Marsell's pace: taking one asks Marsell for the mission due now, and when that is another, it is held for you and the answer names it: do that one, or give it back. A job Marsell confirms itself (setting up a Google Ads account) can be closed by Marsell while it is yours, as soon as Marsell sees the result.

in_missions_profile.description: For a job whose needs is profile, take it with in_missions_profile: true, and only when the browser you are driving right now is the missions profile; the owner's everyday browser is not it, whatever it is signed in to.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

session.description: A short name for this wake of yours (letters, digits, dots, dashes, colons or underscores, up to 64), made up once when the wake starts and passed the same to homework_take and every report of that job. A job is held for the session that took it: another session is refused it, and only the session that took it reports it. Without it, a job your key already holds is refused to a second take, so two wakes never do it twice.

name: homework_take
title: Take a homework job
